program='''def transform(grid):
    a = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(a), len(a[0])
    full_rows = [(r, a[r][0]) for r in range(h) if len(set(a[r])) == 1]
    full_cols = [(c, a[0][c]) for c in range(w) if all(a[r][c] == a[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    for r, value in full_rows:
        if value != 2:
            a[r] = [2 if cell == value else cell for cell in a[r]]
    for c, value in full_cols:
        if value != 2:
            for r in range(h):
                a[r][c] = 2
    return a
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
